exposure: serum progesterone values on the day of frozen blastocyst transfer
cohort: All frozen-thawed embryo transfer cycles performed at the department following in vitro fecundation from May 2018 to June 2019 were included.
finding: The miscarriage rate was higher in women with lower serum progesterone levels (1st quartile) on the day of frozen blastocyst transfer, although no significant differences were found in pregnancy and delivery rates.
